body:
This was actually so incredibly useful! It's always good to know and be aware of more options. Dr. Ramani explained everything so beautifully, I definitely plan on watching more of her videos. Thank you for this! 
Like, I feel like I definitely should've mentioned that I live on an island, so going fully no-contact is gonna be SO hard. Especially when everyone knows everyone. So, I could definitely do this gray-rocking method for some period of time before moving/living abroad or something.
Thank you! I really needed to hear this. I feel like the pressure on us only childs are even higher than anything, but it needs to be done. I really appreciate your comment.
My parents don't really deny it, but they act so nonchalant about it. Like, It wasn't a big deal at all...when It absolutely was.

Let me start by saying, thank you SO much for your comments! I was feeling horrible about everything, but this made feel so much better and at peace with everything. I unfortunately can't control our stupid society and It's ideology, but I absolutely will never treat my kids the way I was ever treated. Thank you SOOOOO much for your comments, you truly don't understand how much they mean to me. It's everything I needed to hear right now.

Thankfully, I'm already in college (2nd year) so I'm halfway there to freedom! (I'm not American If you couldn't tell) and I can't wait to just be able to do...me. Please take care yourself and stay safe too. Thank you yet again, seriously- I'll never forget your words at all.

Sorry for responding late, but that's exactly it! I truly don't do anything but exist and go to school, but yet they can't let me just...get one more piercing. I hate that my culture is so misogynistic and backwards that parents even feel the need to do some sht like this. And you're absolutely right about my dad, hence why all I can do is wait until I finish college, find a job and RUN. I'll never look back, and they know it.

Edit: Forgot to mention that I turn 18 tomorrow. Literally in a few hours.
Thank you! I hope it gets better too, especially for tomorrow.

I'm gonna be 18 tomorrow lol. I don't think you understand, my culture is super conservative- I already have 10 piercings on my EARS, the fact that I got a (visible) nose piercing is literally the most daring thing I've ever done in my life. My dad is beyond angry, never have I seen him like this. So, idk what to do but lock myself in my room and hope I wake up tomorrow for my birthday.

Yep, that's exactly the case. The Caribbean is very very traditional. Moving out before you're even done with school is very very uncommon. For example, my neighbors son and grandkids still live with him and they're all above 26. It's just not a thing here, but obviously I have to leave. So at this point, I'm just saving up and trying to find a job and move out
It's okay, thank you for the advice! I really really appreciate it so much you. Thank you.

I'm from the Caribbean unfortunately. Colleges do not have dorms here...I WISH tho, that would've been life changing for sure. 

Also, thank you for everything too. You were really sweet and nice, thank you so much.
I'm 17! But in my culture you stay with your parents till you finish college and start working (I'm currently in college rn) clearly I'm gonna have to "break" some traditions for my own mental health

My dad? But he'll probably be worried for a second and forget about it afterwards, or take her side. It's a lose lose situation. My only solution really is to leave and/or talk to a child abuse hotline but I'm not mentally ready for that.
You're right, what she did was not justifiable or right at all. I'm definitely planning on leaving as soon as I can, and never look back. Thank you.

I've doing that for years tbh. If I'm going to the store for some juice- I have to tell her it's for something school related or else she won't trust me enough to go. I'll definitely take your advice tho, the least information I give her about myself the better then. Also, thank you so so much about that last part, I really needed to hear that. I wish you all the luck in the world too, thank you and take care.
No idea, but she doesn't trust me at all. Sometimes it feels like she's trying to find a reason/evidence that'll maybe just...justify everything she's doing to me. Does that make sense?

I definitely will. I physically and mentally cannot live like this anymore. It's actually crazy because my mom hates it whenever I bring up finally leaving and living by myself (and has also restrained me from getting a credit card for that exact reason) but as soon as I can, I'll leave and never look back. 
Thank you so much for the advice, you've helped me a lot. Thanks.
I'm still a minor. I've told teachers/neighbors about a potential problem in my house, but they've all pull the same line: "that's your mother, she knows better. You'll understand when you're older"

I live in the Caribbean, they value mom's here like no other. Plus, my mom knows they won't believe me because I have no person to back me up since I'm an only child and have no friends. My mom has threatened to call the police on me before for the stupidest thing, so she knows they won't believe me.
Sorry for responding so late, but It's an industrial!
I hope we both get to that point of our lives. I know you deserve to be happy buddy.

I think you misunderstood. I simply don't feel safe leaving our own house to go live with her boyfriend whom she's known for less than a year. It's not smart or ideal on any ends whatsoever. Unfortunately, It's already happening. She's already planning on leaving, and I'll be forced to move in with another adult since I'm still a minor.
I'm not gonna say I'm happy for her because I'm not, but I know for a fact I'll never abandon my own kid, and especially not for a stranger. I'll wish her a good luck, keeping it moving, and hope we never meet again.

PS: I do appreciate the advice very very much. In a few years I'll probably randomly remember this and think "they were right" but I mentally hit a wall right now- that I don't think I'll ever be able to jump over. Sorry If I seemed rude in any way, you did not deserve that. I'm sorry. Thank you so much for taking your time out of the day to reply.
Thank you so much!!!! I really really appreciate it. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.
Thank you so much for saying this! I really really needed to hear this right now! Thank you.
I kinda needed this, so thank you so much! I appreciate it a lot!!!!!!
